protocol.name: ORED Governance Compiler × PAS 2161 Road-Condition-Monitoring Approval Process

acquisitionSnapshot.reason: 2026 PAS 2161 assessment is still in progress. TRL plans to provide benchmark calibration data on 2026-10-02, receive calibrated technology submissions on 2026-11-06, and announce demonstrated/not-demonstrated results on 2026-12-18.

primaryCandidate.technology: Type S / Road Assessment Vehicle (RAV)-based PAS 2161 method
primaryCandidate.selectionBasis: Provider publicly stated before 2026 outcomes that it intended to enter its Type S RAV-based methodology in the 2026 PAS 2161 demonstration.
primaryCandidate.prior2025InformationAllowedButNotUsedAs2: WDM disclosed that its 2025 Type S submission did not meet acceptance criteria and that it intended to refine the method for the 2026 submission.

prospectiveHoldoutSelection.fallbackRule: If the primary candidate does not participate in 2026 or no complete Tier-A package is obtainable for it, use the first complete 2026 Tier-A technology package publicly released by TRL/DfT in chronological order; if multiple packages are released simultaneously, choose lexicographically by provider then technology name.

currentlyAvailableArtifacts.role: process schedule, route lengths, benchmark/calibration design, pass-mark expectation, QA/outcome timing
2026 trial route package with shapefiles, section lists, engineer guidance and gap-report template
technology-type QA templates and method/consistency fields
frozen 2025 assessment-rule precedent and threshold definitions used to preregister 2026 decision mapping
prospective primary holdout identity and declared 2026 Type S participation intent

missingForTierA: 2026 technology-level official assessment report containing all decision metrics
official 2026 demonstrated/not-demonstrated outcome for the selected technology
selected technology's submitted QA/method identity sufficient to bind the approval to a configuration
official final 2026 criteria/version if changed from the frozen 2025 thresholds
where needed for independent reconstruction, technology-level benchmark/repeat assessment values or official metric table

executionState.claimStatus: No external-validation pass claim permitted at Tier C.
